Evidence:
[1] The third season of the South Korean reality television competition show "K-pop Star" premiered on SBS on November 24, 2013, airing Sunday evenings at 4:55 pm KST as part of the "Good Sunday" lineup.
[2] Kwon Bo-ah (Korean: 권보아 , , Japanese: クォン・ボア, 権宝兒 , born November 5, 1986), commonly stylized and known by her stage name BoA, is a South Korean singer and actress active in South Korea and Japan.
[3] After a seven-month run, the program was cancelled due to low ratings and to make room for "K-pop Star 3", with the final episode airing on November 17, 2013.
[4] BoA was replaced by You Hee-yeol, as she was focusing on her music career instead.
